subject: Capstone accelerator: trial credit bridge & packaging
messages:
From: Emily Torres <emily@capstoneaccelerator.org>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Ng <alex@capstoneaccelerator.org>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capstone request: short trial bridge + credit pooling for demo week

Hi Mina,

Hope you’re well — thanks again for the product intro last week. Quick ask from our side: our upcoming Demo Week (cohort of 9 startups) runs Nov 15–19 and several teams are still completing their integrations. Can Redwood provide a short trial credit bridge (~60k tokens per startup) to cover demo workloads + allow us to pool unused credit for cross-cohort pilot follow-ups?

We’re also evaluating a smooth path to Reserved Capacity for teams that convert after demo week and would like to understand any introductory discounts or packaging you’d recommend.

I attached a one-page SOW for the cohort (Capstone_MVP_SOW.pdf) with rough usage estimates. Can you outline eligibility and any constraints (escrow window, conversion mapping to committed usage, PO requirements)?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — we’re finalizing sponsor comms on Friday.

Best,
Emily Torres
Program Director, Capstone Accelerator
emily@capstoneaccelerator.org

--
Attachment: Capstone_MVP_SOW.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Torres <emily@capstoneaccelerator.org>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capstone request: short trial bridge + credit pooling for demo week

Hi Emily — thanks for the details and the SOW. Happy to help, and looping in Ben (partner programs) and Irene (commercial/legal). A few quick clarifying Qs so we scope the ask properly:

- Are all 9 startups requesting the same 60k token uplift, or is that an average?
- Do any cohort teams qualify as non-profits or government-funded (that may affect billing/tax treatment)?
- For conversion path: do you want credits to map 1:1 to committed tokens (i.e., convert leftover trial credits into a prepaid deduction) or to function as a promotional credit applied at invoice time?

I’ve attached our standard trial terms for reference (redwood_trial_terms_v3.pdf). Once we confirm these points I’ll propose an internal approval path and a draft addendum for DocuSign.

Proposed turnaround: internal yes/no by EOD Wed, external follow-up Thur.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: redwood_trial_terms_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Torres <emily@capstoneaccelerator.org>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capstone request: short trial bridge + credit pooling for demo week

Thanks Mina — quick proposal from Partner Programs below. Emily, feel free to push back.

Proposal (conditional):
- Trial bridge: 60k token credit per startup for the cohort (9 startups) to be issued as promotional credits; credits valid for 90 days from issue.
- Escrow/pooling: We can allow a single pool for demos (Capstone-managed), but unused promotional credits must be claimed by a converted startup within 90 days. Credits are non-transferable outside the cohort.
- Conversion incentive: 20% off list Dedicated pricing for any cohort company that signs a 12-month reserved capacity commitment within 60 days after demo week. Discount applies to the first 12 months only.
- Non-profit carveout: we can entertain an additional 10% discount for recognized non-profits — provide documentation.

Constraints / operational notes:
- Credits cannot be escrowed longer than 90 days without executive approval.
- PO/Invoice: For commitments we need PO or signed contract; onboarding credits are applied after DocuSign is complete.
- Tax/accounting: credits are treated as promotional discounts — accounting should be aware for grant-funded teams.

Next steps:
1) Emily: confirm cohort list + any non-profits by EOD Thurs.
2) Mina/Irene: draft short addendum for signature and confirm whether Capstone wants pooled escrow or per-company issuance.
3) If approved, operations will issue promo credits within 48 hours of signed addendum.

Ben Carter
Head of Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
--
(attachment: pricing-addendum-draft.docx)

From: Emily Torres <emily@capstoneaccelerator.org>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alex Ng <alex@capstoneaccelerator.org>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capstone request: short trial bridge + credit pooling for demo week

Hi Ben/Mina — this is great, thanks. A couple quick clarifications:

- Pooling: Capstone prefers a pooled escrow (single pool we distribute internally) to simplify logistics.
- Non-profits: Two of the cohort teams are 501(c)(3)s — I’ll send docs by EOD Thursday.
- DocuSign: please send a simple addendum (one page) we can sign — would prefer an explicit line that promo credits can be applied to the first invoice if a company converts to Dedicated.

Also — is there any flexibility on the 90-day escrow window? Some of our sponsors ask for extended follow-up windows.

Thanks — Emily

Emily — thanks, all set to move forward. Summary of agreed path below (please confirm):

- Promo credits: 60k tokens per cohort company (9 companies) issued as promotional credits.
- Escrow: pooled Capstone-managed pool; Redwood issues credits to cohort pool.
- Validity: standard 90-day validity; Capstone (as accredited incubator) has an approved extension up to 120 days for this cohort.
- Conversion incentive: 20% off first 12 months of Dedicated pricing for companies that sign a 12-month Reserved Commitment within 60 days after demo week. Non-profits receive an extra 10% on submission of documentation.
- Operations: credits will be issued within 48 hours of signed addendum + DocuSign completion.

Next steps:
1) Emily: confirm final cohort list + the two non-profits and sign the addendum via DocuSign (link: https://docusign.com/link/to/addendum/ABC-123).
2) Mina/Irene: finalize addendum and route for signature.
3) Ops: create pooled escrow and sub-accounts for tracking; issue credits on signature.

If that looks right I’ll send the DocuSign package and calendar invite for the onboarding call (Nov 1, 10:00 PT) — please confirm availability.

Thanks — Mina
